note: Named, leased exemptions for the real-tree worktree/branch audit (issues #1291, #1311, #1321). Each entry excuses ONE artifact — kind, name, and the tip the exemption was measured at — and only while the lease below holds AND this document is in force in the venue the check is running in: `venue.git_common_dir` names the repository instance (every worktree of one checkout, lane worktrees included, answers it; no other clone does). At that venue every rule bites: a new artifact is never absorbed (it is not listed); an artifact whose tip has moved is not absorbed (it is no longer the artifact named here); an entry that no longer targets an unmatched artifact FAILS as a stale exemption; and an entry that is honoured but no longer NEEDED is REFUTED and FAILS by name (issue #1311) — an artifact whose whole committed work is already on the default branch by `git patch-id --stable`, and a worktree that holds no uncommitted work of its own, is holding nothing an exemption protects, and its home is real-tree-baseline.json instead. That rule is why this document shrank by 18 entries in the #1311 edit (15 refuted by exactly that proof, 3 whose work a live `git ls-remote` showed preserved on a remote branch — all 18 moved to the reviewed baseline), and by one more in the same lane: `worktree /tmp/ao968-pristine` was reaped by the machine's own `/tmp` scratch guard and the file it held uncommitted (`portal/tests/test_fleet_syspath_isolation.py`) is on the default branch (`3aadeda0`, #968) — a resolution, so its entry was removed rather than restated. 15 were refuted by exactly that proof and 3 more had their work preserved on a remote branch (measured live with `git ls-remote`), so all 18 moved to the reviewed baseline. At ANOTHER venue the whole document is inert — reported entry by entry as NOT-APPLICABLE, honouring nothing (an artifact that is unmatched there stays a finding: this document does not speak for that checkout) and not fatal (a stale exemption is a claim about THIS disk, which another checkout cannot observe). That distinction is the fix for #1317, which emptied this document because its entries could never be honoured on a pristine clone — a true measurement whose remedy un-quarantined all of them on the one box that has them. This document's tracker moved once more in the #1311 edit: its predecessor #1311 was the tracker for the whole set while it shrank from 25 entries to 7, and the residual would have lapsed the moment #1311 closed — so the lease names #1338, the issue that owns the 7 remaining per-artifact owner calls, measured open over REST at write time. Closing a tracker lapses its exemptions; the tracker is therefore always an issue that is meant to stay open while entries remain. Every remaining entry is the AGENTS.md rule 17 class, re-measured at the timestamp in its own reason: work that exists nowhere else, which the worker is forbidden to discard, so it must be reported rather than silently red — and reported rather than silently reaped. RETIRED 2026-09-19T21:12Z by the #1485 lane at origin/master 9c2c68fe: this document declares no exemptions any more, so its lease is inert (the empty-document rule in real_tree_baseline.py - a lease bounding no entry cannot turn anything green, so failing on it would be a formality) and it can no longer lapse on the 24h clock and red the whole fleet. Each of the six entries it carried was re-measured, its rule 17 basis was ENDED by parking the work on a remote ref rather than restated, and the artifact was then recorded, reviewed, by name in real-tree-baseline.json. The pushes: origin/rescue/issue-1028-canon = 88ea96d70a3f and origin/rescue/issue-830-reaper-schedule = af843aaf8289 (both creates, because neither local tip descends from the same-named origin branch), origin/rescue/agent-ad284eb-ticket-conftest = 6d47b5abdc35 (parent origin/master, carrying governance/ticket/tests/conftest.py at sha256 af180c20a113), plus the two a peer lane had already preserved: origin/issue-1114-dispatch-master-green = d084114b73e8 and origin/fix/1042-governance-test-basenames = 47ac6de35e04. Nothing local was deleted: all six artifacts are still on this box with their tips, which is why they are recorded rather than reaped. tracked_by stays #1338 - the per-artifact resolution decision (land it, keep it, or authorise its deletion) is still owed by its owner, and any FUTURE rule 17 artifact needs a new entry here, measured, not this one restored.

venue.why: The repository instance these exemptions were measured in — every worktree of this checkout (lane worktrees included) resolves to it, and no pristine clone does. Without it, `the artifact is gone` and `the artifact was never here` are indistinguishable, which is what made #1317 empty this document.
